qualificationText.TF192-Q-BALANCE: No balance approval or quantitative balance validation.
qualificationText.TF192-Q-COMPLETION: Four held proposals do not assert rule review, engine, game or domain completion.
qualificationText.TF192-Q-COSMOLOGY: No new soul/Hunt/finality, planar or cosmology authority; a400day calendar year is not a primordial epoch.
qualificationText.TF192-Q-DOMAIN: No time/causality, spell domain or whole-game domain closure.
qualificationText.TF192-Q-PHYSICAL: Actors, body/hand/focus, geometry, support, cargo, custody, witnesses and campaign facts in traces are explicit conditional scenario operands, not authenticated campaign data.
qualificationText.TF192-Q-PLAY: No human playtest or live campaign execution occurred.
qualificationText.TF192-Q-RELEASE: No shipping, release or selectable-runtime authorization; canonical application reserved to the owner.
qualificationText.TF192-Q-RUNTIME: No game or supplied/historical program executed. JSON replay is static evidence, not engine implementation or runtime approval.
qualificationText.TF192-Q-SOURCE: Exact native cards, all access rows, acquisition, authoritative snapshots and source permissions remain controlling; no later backing-source change becomes accepted without matching evidence.
